modifier.toxic-modifier.name: Toxic
modifier.toxic-modifier.desc: §oTOXIC AVENGER!§r\nMercury and it's ethyl and methyl salts are extremely toxic and have neuro-degenerative effects.\nAdding some to a weapon or tool gives it the ability to poison and temporarily blind your enemies.
modifier.lead-plated.name: Lead Plated
modifier.lead-plated.desc: §oSafety First§r\nIf you've got some Plutonium or Uranium around and think it'd be great for a weapon, don't forget to add some shielding.\nA nice lead plate will stop the deadly radiation from affection you while still letting it harm your enemies.

modifier.mmd-poisonous_armor.desc: Rather dangerous - will poison things when hit by them.
modifier.mmd-toxic_armor.name: Toxic
modifier.mmd-toxic_armor.desc: Rather dangerous - will poison and blind things when hit by them.

modifier.mmd-reactive_armor.desc: Reacts with water to wear out faster
modifier.mmd-brittle_armor.name: Brittle
modifier.mmd-sparkly.name: Sparkly
modifier.mmd-soft.name: Soft
modifier.mmd-soft.desc: Not really good for tools that will see a lot of use as they'll wear out faster
modifier.mmd-icy_armor.name: Eternal Ice
modifier.mmd-icy_armor.desc: This material is so cold not even the ever burning fires of the Nether can make you sweat
modifier.mmd-malleable_armor.name: Malleable
modifier.mmd-malleable_armor.desc: Perhaps appropriate for armors that will see a lot of use as they'll wear out slower
config.basemetals.title: Base Metals Settings
config.basemetals.contentMode.tooltip: Choose how freely you can craft with metals. Ore generation stays the same.
config.basemetals.content_mode.high_fant: Craft freely with every metal. All recipes, villager trades and chest loot are available.
config.basemetals.content_mode.low_fanta: Keep fantasy metals, but limit what you can make from each material. No Base Metals bows, crossbows or fishing rods.
config.basemetals.specialEffects.tooltip: Give certain metals their special armour and melee bonuses, such as breathing underwater in a full Aquarium suit.
Starsteel equipment repairs itself while held: 1 durability every 10 seconds. Armour does not self-repair.
config.basemetals.mercuryImmersionEffect: Touching liquid mercury can make you nauseous.
config.basemetals.villagerTrades.tooltip: Let blacksmiths sell Base Metals ingots and equipment.
config.basemetals.confirm.title: Change content mode?
config.basemetals.confirm.message: Restart Minecraft to use the new mode. You can still use everything you already own. To play on a server, choose the same mode as the server.
config.basemetals.restart: Restart Minecraft after changing modes. This choice applies to all your worlds. Use OreSpawn to change where ores generate.
config.basemetals.connection.mismatch: This server uses %s, but your game uses %s. Choose the same content mode in Mods → Base Metals → Config, then restart Minecraft.
